verses.en: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.pt: Melhor é um bocado seco, e com ele a tranqüilidade, do que a casa cheia de festins, com rixas.
verses.en_web: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.en_bbe: Better a bit of dry bread in peace, than a house full of feasting and violent behaviour.

verses.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.pt: O servo prudente dominará sobre o filho que procede indignamente; e entre os irmãos receberá da herança.
verses.en_web: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
verses.en_bbe: A servant who does wisely will have rule over a son causing shame, and will have his part in the heritage among brothers.

verses.en: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
verses.pt: O crisol é para a prata, e o forno para o ouro; mas o Senhor é que prova os corações.
verses.en_web: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
verses.en_bbe: The heating-pot is for silver and the oven-fire for gold, but the Lord is the tester of hearts.

verses.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.pt: O malfazejo atenta para o lábio iníquo; o mentiroso inclina os ouvidos para a língua maligna.
verses.en_web: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.en_bbe: A wrongdoer gives attention to evil lips, and a man of deceit gives ear to a damaging tongue.

verses.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.pt: O que escarnece do pobre insulta ao seu Criador; o que se alegra da calamidade não ficará impune.
verses.en_web: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
verses.en_bbe: Whoever makes sport of the poor puts shame on his Maker; and he who is glad because of trouble will not go free from punishment.

verses.en: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.pt: Coroa dos velhos são os filhos dos filhos; e a glória dos filhos são seus pais.
verses.en_web: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
verses.en_bbe: Children's children are the crown of old men, and the glory of children is their fathers.

verses.en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.pt: Não convém ao tolo a fala excelente; quanto menos ao príncipe o lábio mentiroso!
verses.en_web: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
verses.en_bbe: Fair words are not to be looked for from a foolish man, much less are false lips in a ruler.

verses.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.pt: Pedra preciosa é a peita aos olhos de quem a oferece; para onde quer que ele se volte, serve-lhe de proveito.
verses.en_web: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
verses.en_bbe: An offering of money is like a stone of great price in the eyes of him who has it: wherever he goes, he does well.

verses.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
verses.pt: O que perdoa a transgressão busca a amizade; mas o que renova a questão, afastam amigos íntimos.
verses.en_web: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps a sin covered is looking for love; but he who keeps on talking of a thing makes division between friends.

verses.en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.pt: Mais profundamente entra a repreensão no prudente, do que cem açoites no insensato.
verses.en_web: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
verses.en_bbe: A word of protest goes deeper into one who has sense than a hundred blows into a foolish man.

verses.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.pt: O rebelde não busca senão o mal; portanto um mensageiro cruel será enviado contra ele.
verses.en_web: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.en_bbe: An uncontrolled man is only looking for trouble, so a cruel servant will be sent against him.

verses.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.pt: Encontre-se o homem com a ursa roubada dos filhotes, mas não com o insensato na sua estultícia.
verses.en_web: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.en_bbe: It is better to come face to face with a bear whose young ones have been taken away than with a foolish man acting foolishly.

verses.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.pt: Quanto àquele que torna mal por bem, não se apartará o mal da sua casa.
verses.en_web: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.en_bbe: If anyone gives back evil for good, evil will never go away from his house.

verses.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.pt: O princípio da contenda é como o soltar de águas represadas; deixa por isso a porfia, antes que haja rixas.
verses.en_web: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
verses.en_bbe: The start of fighting is like the letting out of water: so give up before it comes to blows.

verses.en: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
verses.pt: O que justifica o ímpio, e o que condena o justo, são abomináveis ao Senhor, tanto um como o outro.
verses.en_web: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: He who gives a decision for the evil-doer and he who gives a decision against the upright, are equally disgusting to the Lord.

verses.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
verses.pt: De que serve o preço na mão do tolo para comprar a sabedoria, visto que ele não tem entendimento?
verses.en_web: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
verses.en_bbe: How will money in the hand of the foolish get him wisdom, seeing that he has no sense?

verses.en: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.pt: O amigo ama em todo o tempo; e para a angústia nasce o irmão.
verses.en_web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.en_bbe: A friend is loving at all times, and becomes a brother in times of trouble.

verses.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.pt: O homem falto de entendimento compromete-se, tornando-se fiador na presença do seu vizinho.
verses.en_web: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.en_bbe: A man without sense gives his hand in an agreement, and makes himself responsible before his neighbour.

verses.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.pt: O que ama a contenda ama a transgressao; o que faz alta a sua porta busca a ruína.
verses.en_web: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
verses.en_bbe: The lover of fighting is a lover of sin: he who makes high his doorway is looking for destruction.

verses.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.pt: O perverso de coração nunca achará o bem; e o que tem a língua dobre virá a cair no mal.
verses.en_web: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
verses.en_bbe: Nothing good comes to him whose heart is fixed on evil purposes: and he who has an evil tongue will come to trouble.

verses.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.pt: O que gera um tolo, para sua tristeza o faz; e o pai do insensato não se alegrará.
verses.en_web: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
verses.en_bbe: He who has an unwise son gets sorrow for himself, and the father of a foolish son has no joy.

verses.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.pt: O coração alegre serve de bom remédio; mas o espírito abatido seca os ossos.
verses.en_web: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
verses.en_bbe: A glad heart makes a healthy body, but a crushed spirit makes the bones dry.

verses.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.pt: O ímpio recebe do regaço a peita, para perverter as veredas da justiça.
verses.en_web: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
verses.en_bbe: A sinner takes an offering out of his robe, to get a decision for himself in a cause.

verses.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.pt: O alvo do inteligente é a sabedoria; mas os olhos do insensato estão nas extremidades da terra.
verses.en_web: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Wisdom is before the face of him who has sense; but the eyes of the foolish are on the ends of the earth.

verses.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.pt: O filho insensato é tristeza para seu, pai, e amargura para quem o deu à luz.
verses.en_web: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
verses.en_bbe: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitter pain to her who gave him birth.

verses.en: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
verses.pt: Não é bom punir ao justo, nem ferir aos nobres por causa da sua retidão.
verses.en_web: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
verses.en_bbe: To give punishment to the upright is not good, or to give blows to the noble for their righteousness.

verses.en: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.pt: Refreia as suas palavras aquele que possui o conhecimento; e o homem de entendimento é de espírito sereno.
verses.en_web: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
verses.en_bbe: He who has knowledge says little: and he who has a calm spirit is a man of good sense.

verses.en: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
verses.pt: Até o tolo, estando calado, é tido por sábio; e o que cerra os seus lábios, por entendido.
verses.en_web: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
verses.en_bbe: Even the foolish man, when he keeps quiet, is taken to be wise: when his lips are shut he is credited with good sense.
